notes: Internal bullish CHoCH on 1h, the default timeframe, gave 1,990 entries in 1,943 separate moves. Twenty candles later, they were 0.04% ahead of random entries, inside a luck band of -0.14% to 0.13%. On the short side, the bearish CHoCH landed in the same place: 0.06% inside a band of -0.12% to 0.17%. Both stayed inside the band on 4h and daily too.

Swing signals are rare next to internal ones. On 1h, internal bullish CHoCH enters about seven times as often as swing bullish BoS. Swing bullish BoS on daily has 13 entries, under the 30 episodes a verdict needs, and none in downtrends. Swing BoS on 4h and internal BoS on daily also have too few downtrend entries to judge.

Bullish market structure holds on most candles: 86,388 entries on 1h, but only 272 separate moves. It sat inside the band on 1h and 4h, in uptrends and in downtrends. On daily it has only 11 moves, too few to judge, and its uptrend side is too few as well.

Split by regime, the bearish CHoCH pulls apart, but no side holds. On 4h in uptrends the short beat random by 0.75%, and in downtrends it trailed by 0.84%. Each rests on a single entry, on May 16, 2021 and Jan 11, 2023, and turns to chance without it. On daily in downtrends it beat random by 5.05%, from one signal on Nov 8, 2022, during the FTX collapse. In daily uptrends it showed nothing.

Price crossing up any high on daily beat random by 2.92%, past the band's top of 2.57%. It shows at 10 candles but not at 50 or 100, and only in uptrends; in downtrends it showed nothing. On 4h, the same cross in uptrends and the cross down through any low in downtrends also cleared the band. Each one fades without its strongest stretch or at the other horizons.

For a DCA bot, a CHoCH or BoS start condition timed entries no better than a random candle on these pairs, so the take profit and DCA orders do the work. Bullish structure as a filter beside other conditions did not change the result either, so leaving it out costs nothing. The daily cross above a prior high is the one shape worth testing on your own pair, and it breaks when a single rally like SOL's does not repeat.
